record.title: Delayed Costs Data in the Compliance API

updates.body: We have identified an issue causing delays in publishing Organization cost data through the Costs API. API and ChatGPT usage are not affected. We are working to restore normal data freshness.
We’ve applied a mitigation and are monitoring the affected services to confirm recovery. Delays in cost data are still expected.
